title: monday.com Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Collaborative Work Management for the Fourth Consecutive Year - monday.com
summary: monday.com is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Collaborative Work Management for the fourth year, furthest for Completeness of Vision.
body_markdown:
[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) *Positioned Furthest for Completeness of Vision and Highest for Ability to Execute for the Second Consecutive Year*


*Fourth Consecutive Year Named A Leader The Report*


NEW YORK & TEL AVIV, Israel–(BUSINESS WIRE)–[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) (NASDAQ: MNDY) today announced it has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Collaborative Work Management (CWM) for the fourth consecutive year. Having been named a Leader every year since the report’s inception, monday.com continues to invest in helping organizations plan, coordinate, and execute work at scale, and its early transformation into a workspace where AI agents are collaborative participants in that work instead of just an add-on.


In the 2026 report,[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) was positioned furthest for Completeness of Vision and highest for Ability to Execute among all vendors evaluated, the second consecutive year it has held this position on both axes. In the accompanying 2026 Gartner Critical Capabilities for Collaborative Work Management report,[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) was the highest-scoring vendor in three of the seven use cases evaluated: Work Planning and Execution; Intake, Triage, and Service Operations; and Product Management Operations.[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://operations.monday.com/) also placed among the three highest-scoring vendors across all seven use cases.


Over the past year,[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) committed fully to the AI Workspace, where people and AI agents plan and execute work on a shared, governed data and workflow layer. This comes to life through:


- **AI agents that do the work:** Agents on[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) act directly on platform data and workflows, taking on tasks end-to-end alongside the teams they support.
- **Built for business teams:** Any team can configure workflows, automate multi-step processes, and build custom applications, including through natural language with monday vibe, without writing code or waiting on IT.
- **One workspace, from a single team to the whole enterprise:** Every[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) product runs on the same AI layer, giving organizations one connected platform with the visibility and controls enterprises need to move quickly without compromising security.


“We’re excited to be recognized by Gartner as a Leader for the fourth year in a row,” said Daniel Lereya, Chief Product and Technology Officer at[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) . “Our strength has always been the core of work management: helping teams plan, track, and deliver collaboratively with clarity. Today, by bringing AI agents and people together as teammates on the same data, context, and workflows, we’re allowing organizations to embrace AI across virtually every use case, challenge, and sector, at enterprise scale. We’re proud to keep raising the bar for how AI reshapes work, helping companies accelerate into the AI era with all the knowledge and context they’ve been building on[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) from day one.”


The Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM report provides a graphical competitive positioning of four types of technology providers in markets where growth is high and provider differentiation is distinct. Read the complimentary report[here (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/w/analyst-recognitions) to learn more about why[monday.com (opens new tab)](https://monday.com/) was recognized as a Leader.
